entities.name: Mesopotamian Marriage Contracts
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The world's oldest written marriage contracts come from Sumer. Marriage was a legal transaction between families — the groom paid a bride price (terhatum) and the bride's family provided a dowry. Hammurabi's Code (1754 BCE) codified divorce rights, adultery penalties, and inheritance rules.
